match_nodes.description: Washington My Health My Data Act

data.description: Washington state law protecting consumer health data not covered by HIPAA. Effective March 31, 2024.

data.official_name: Washington House Bill 2225 — Concerning Artificial Intelligence Companion Chatbots
data.description: Washington State statute regulating AI companion chatbots: requires clear and periodic disclosure that the user is interacting with an AI system, prohibits deceptive human or licensed-clinician impersonation, mandates crisis intervention protocols for suicidal ideation, self-harm, and eating-disorder triggers, and establishes minor protections enforced under the Washington Consumer Protection Act (RCW 19.86).
data.notes: Status: Enacted in 2026; effective January 1, 2027 (signed by Governor Ferguson following the 2026 Regular Session; verified as of 2026-11-03).
